nodes.description: Public state variable holding the maximum token supply (333).
Public state variable holding the whitelist/presale price in wei (0.08 ETH).
Public state variable holding the public sale price in wei (0.1 ETH).
Public boolean flag controlling whether public minting is enabled.
Public boolean flag controlling whether whitelist presale minting is enabled.
Private base URI string used to build token metadata URIs.
Private Merkle root used by the whitelist proof verification.
External payable mint function taking an amount and a Merkle proof; guards sale state, tx.origin, amount bounds, supply and price.
onlyOwner function that updates the public sale PRICE.
onlyOwner function that updates MAX_TOKENS supply cap.
onlyOwner function toggling the public sale flag.
onlyOwner function toggling the presale flag.
onlyOwner function sending 10 percent of the contract balance to the owner via transfer.
onlyOwner function sending the whole contract balance to the owner via transfer.
onlyOwner function transferring an arbitrary ETH amount to an arbitrary winner address.
onlyOwner function updating the Merkle root used for the whitelist.
Internal view function building the leaf from msg.sender and checking it against the Merkle root.
Public view pseudo-random generator built from block.timestamp, block.difficulty and msg.sender.
Public view function selecting a winner index from a chances array using getRandomNumber modulo totalChance.
onlyOwner function updating the base token URI.
Public view function returning metadata URI for a token id.
Internal function writing the base token URI state variable.
Internal view function returning the stored base token URI.
ERC721Enumerable transfer hook override invoked on mint, burn and transfer.
ERC165 interface support override.
Constructor setting token name and symbol through the ERC721 base constructor.
Caller-controlled address used for minting recipient, whitelist leaf and owner checks.
Transaction origin used in mintToken as an anti-contract guard.
Block timestamp used as randomness entropy in getRandomNumber.
External call performed by _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract, enabling reentrancy.
payable(owner()).transfer((address(this).balance / 100) * 10) ETH value transfer.
payable(owner()).transfer(address(this).balance) full balance ETH transfer.
payable(winner).transfer(amount) ETH transfer to an owner-supplied address.
Arithmetic computation price * amount used in the msg.value requirement.
Arithmetic computation totalSupply() + amount compared against MAX_TOKENS.
Arithmetic modulo of the pseudo-random number by totalChance plus chances accumulation in pickWinner.
MerkleProof.verify used as a whitelist gate inside verify().
amount parameter of mintToken, user-controlled number of NFTs to mint.
proof parameter of mintToken, user-supplied Merkle proof array.

newMaxTokens parameter of setMaxTokens.

amount parameter of transferReward.
_root parameter of setRoot.
baseURI parameter of setBaseURI.
tokenId parameter of tokenURI.
chances array parameter of pickWinner.
totalChance parameter of pickWinner.
proof parameter of the internal verify function.
Local price variable chosen between WHITELIST_PRICE and PRICE in mintToken.
Loop counter i in mintToken.
Local leaf hash computed from msg.sender in verify.

Local accumulator currNum in pickWinner.
Local index traversing the chances array in pickWinner.

edges.reason: mintToken reads saleIsActive inside the sale-state requirement.
mintToken reads preSaleIsActive to decide sale mode and pricing.
PRICE is assigned to the local price variable for the public sale path.
WHITELIST_PRICE is assigned to the local price variable for the presale path.
MAX_TOKENS is the bound compared against the totalSupply() + amount arithmetic.
verify reads the root state variable to check the Merkle proof.
mintToken relies on tx.origin for the no-smart-contract guard, which is spoofable/phishable and breaks meta-transaction and contract-wallet composability.
msg.sender is the mint recipient passed to _safeMint.
msg.sender is hashed into the Merkle leaf inside verify.
getRandomNumber depends on block.timestamp (and block.difficulty), making the randomness miner/validator-influenceable timestamp dependency.
msg.sender is mixed into the pseudo-random hash in getRandomNumber.
pickWinner calls getRandomNumber to obtain the modulo base value.
setPrice is protected by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
setMaxTokens is protected by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
flipSaleState is protected by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
flipPreSaleState is protected by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
withdraw10 is protected by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
withdrawTotal is protected by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
transferReward is protected by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
setRoot is protected by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
setBaseURI is protected by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
The amount parameter drives the mint loop count and value checks.
The proof parameter is forwarded to verify for the whitelist check.
newPrice parameter is written into PRICE.
newMaxTokens parameter is written into MAX_TOKENS.
winner parameter is the destination of the ETH transfer in transferReward.
amount parameter is the value transferred in transferReward.
_root parameter is written into the root state variable.
baseURI parameter is forwarded to _setBaseURI.
tokenId parameter is used for the existence check and metadata lookup.
chances array is iterated in pickWinner.
totalChance parameter is the modulo denominator in pickWinner.
proof parameter is passed to MerkleProof.verify.
The local price multiplies with amount in the msg.value requirement.
amount is the multiplier in the price * amount arithmetic.
amount is added to totalSupply() in the supply arithmetic.
totalChance is the modulo divisor in the random winner arithmetic.
chances elements are accumulated in the pickWinner loop arithmetic.
numWinner is the dividend of the modulo operation.
currNum accumulator drives the pickWinner while loop.
index tracks the position in the chances array.
The leaf local variable is compared against the Merkle root in verify.
The loop counter i controls the mint loop in mintToken.
mintToken calls _safeMint which performs an external onERC721Received call to the recipient contract.
The onERC721Received callback can re-enter mintToken during the mint loop before the mint completes.
The _safeMint path triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook override.
mintToken computes price * amount for the msg.value requirement.
mintToken computes totalSupply() + amount for the supply cap check.
mintToken invokes the internal verify function for presale proofs.
withdraw10 executes an ETH transfer to the owner.
withdrawTotal executes an ETH transfer of the whole balance to the owner.
transferReward executes an ETH transfer to the winner address.
verify relies on the Merkle proof gate which, with tx.origin-style mint guards and a settable root, defines the whitelist access control.
pickWinner performs modulo and accumulation arithmetic on the random number and chances.
setPrice writes the new value into the PRICE state variable.
setMaxTokens writes the new value into the MAX_TOKENS state variable.
flipSaleState writes the negated flag into saleIsActive.
flipPreSaleState writes the negated flag into preSaleIsActive.
setRoot writes the new Merkle root into the root state variable.
setBaseURI delegates to the internal _setBaseURI.
_setBaseURI writes the base URI into _baseTokenURI.
tokenURI reads the base URI from _baseURI.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter exists only inside mintToken and directly drives its logic.
The proof parameter exists only inside mintToken and is forwarded to verify.
newPrice is the sole parameter of setPrice and is written into PRICE.
newMaxTokens is the sole parameter of setMaxTokens and is written into MAX_TOKENS.
winner is the ETH transfer destination parameter of transferReward.
amount is the ETH transfer value parameter of transferReward.
_root is the sole parameter of setRoot and is written into root.
baseURI is the sole parameter of setBaseURI and is forwarded to _setBaseURI.
tokenId is the sole parameter of tokenURI used for existence and metadata lookup.
chances is a parameter of pickWinner iterated in its accumulation loop.
totalChance is the modulo divisor in the unsafe random-modulo arithmetic.
proof is the sole array parameter of the internal verify function.
The price local is a temporary used only for the price * amount arithmetic.
The loop counter i exists only inside the mintToken loop.
The leaf local is computed and consumed only inside verify.
numWinner is the dividend produced by the random modulo arithmetic.
currNum is the loop accumulator limited to pickWinner.
index is the array traversal counter limited to pickWinner.
